latest.title: Eli Lilly takes weight-loss pill battle global with first Foundayo approval in Europe
latest.description: Lilly's Foundayo wins U.K. approval, taking its weight-loss pill battle with Novo Nordisk's Wegovy beyond the U.S. market.

latest.title: Polymarket makes moves to get house in order before expected boom times for prediction markets this fall
latest.description: The marketing changes come amid an investigation by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission into the company's promotional practices.

latest.title: Wall Street just endorsed Jensen Huang's 'big concept' for AI. What now?
latest.description: The first three-plus years of the AI build-out have been funded by record amounts of equity and debt issued by leading tech companies. Nvidia has a new idea.

latest.title: ADI Chain, Shipfinex partner to tokenize $500M vessel pipeline
latest.description: Shipfinex plans to bring 35 vessels onchain through ADI Chain as tokenization expands into the multitrillion-dollar maritime industry.

latest.title: Parents could put pre-tax paycheck money into Trump Accounts, with employers matching, Treasury says
latest.description: The U.S. Department of Treasury issued guidance that could allow parents to make pre-tax contributions to a child's Trump Account directly from their paycheck.

latest.title: Pakistan signals progress on U.S.-Iran deal as Washington and Tehran trade reparation demands
latest.description: The dueling positions Washington and Tehran staked out showed how far apart the two sides remain even as both talked of winding down regional hostilities.

latest.title: Luke Dashjr Removed as BIP Editor After BIP-110 Bitcoin Fork Stalls
latest.description: Supporters of the soft fork he championed split onto their own chain on Saturday, where it mined two blocks in eight hours and stopped.

latest.title: SharpLink reports $394M in Q2 net loss fueled by ETH decline
latest.description: SharpLink reported a net loss of $394 million in the second quarter of 2026, largely driven by Ether’s 23% decline during the quarter.

latest.title: Pokémon cards are becoming multibillion dollar market. Crypto wants to fix how they trade
latest.description: Collectors are spending millions on trading cards, while blockchain startups are turning physical Pokémon cards into digital assets. The harder task is creating enough liquidity to compete with established marketplaces.

latest.title: We're starting a position in a memory maker that was just put in the Bullpen
latest.description: This stock is one of the more volatile names in the market, prone to big swings.

latest.title: My 401(k) fully vests this month—why my latest work anniversary is worth thousands
latest.description: Many companies contribute to employee retirement accounts, but depending on your firm's rules you may forfeit some or all of it if you leave.

latest.title: Zelenskyy warns Putin is preparing for escalation by bringing in North Korean military equipment
latest.description: His comments come shortly after deadly Russian attacks on cities across Ukraine overnight.

latest.title: EToro to buy TradeZero as Q2 crypto revenue falls 30%
latest.description: Trading platform eToro will acquire TradeZero as part of its US expansion as it reported crypto-related revenue fell by about 30% compared to the second quarter of 2025.

latest.title: Morning Minute: Saylor's Strategy Sells Bitcoin for Second Week in a Row
latest.description: Strategy dumped $108M in BTC at a loss and a whopping $650M of MSTR stock, and yet MSTR stock barely flinched. What gives?

latest.title: U.S. oil price hovers around $82 as traders weigh conflicting signals on Strait of Hormuz deal
latest.description: U.S. oil had risen as much as 3% earlier in the day after President Donald Trump demanded that Iran pay reparations to the U.S.

latest.title: Russia proposes exchange trading of Bitcoin, Ether and Tether’s USDT
latest.description: Russia’s central bank proposed allowing Bitcoin, Ether and USDT to trade on regulated exchanges, following a law signed by President Vladimir Putin last week.

latest.title: North Korea Now Leans on Crime Networks to Launder Stolen Crypto: RUSI
latest.description: Once its proceeds mix with scam money, exchanges struggle to separate proliferation finance from ordinary laundering, the paper warns.

latest.title: MoneyGram expands on Solana with global crypto-to-cash service
latest.description: Wallets and apps on Solana can now tap MoneyGram's global network to move between digital assets and local currencies.

latest.title: Baby products company Frida is expanding into kids’ personal care
latest.description: Baby products company Frida is launching a new category of personal care items for kids, tapping into a growing market and largely untapped space.
